headline: World Cup final: Argentina fan commits suicide after dispute with wife
summary: Sumon Hossain returned home late after watching the final; his body was found hanging in his room the next morning.
details: Sumon Hossain, an Argentina supporter, allegedly committed suicide after a dispute with his wife.
The incident occurred after he returned home late at night following the World Cup final match.
Police recovered his body hanging from his room the following morning.
The tragedy highlights the emotional toll of sports fandom and domestic disputes.
caption:

Sumon Hossain, an Argentina supporter, allegedly committed suicide after a dispute with his wife.

Police recovered his body hanging from his room the following morning.

The tragedy highlights the emotional toll of sports fandom and domestic disputes.

headline_marked: 2 youths [[killed in collision between brick trolley and motorcycle]] in Jessore
headline: 2 youths killed in collision between brick trolley and motorcycle in Jessore
summary: The victims were heading to a tea stall after watching a football match when the accident occurred in Sharsha Upazila.
details: Two young men were killed in a head-on collision between a brick-carrying trolley and a motorcycle in the Sharsha Upazila of Jessore.
The accident took place on Monday morning near Rudrapur village in the Goga Union of Sharsha Upazila.
The deceased have been identified as Mridul Hasan Nahid (25) and Sohag Hossain Usha (27), both residents of Daulatpur village under Benapole Port Police Station.
According to local sources, the three friends—Nahid, Usha, and Rubel—were riding to a tea stall after watching the Argentina-Spain final match on Sunday night.
The collision occurred when a fast-moving trolley coming from a brick kiln lost control and collided head-on with the motorcycle.
Another passenger on the motorcycle, Rubel (30), the trolley driver Amirul, and the helper Nirab were seriously injured and are currently receiving treatment.
Sharsha Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Shamimul Islam stated that legal action will be taken after investigating the cause of the accident.
